original_method: After an owner field-to-structure decision, collect complete Type 20 plus referenced Type 17/19 and any approved companion structures, reconcile ranges/handles/interleave topology against the recipe before and after one authorized reboot, and preserve all logs.
manual_activity: The owner maps the mixed fields, supplies Type 17/19/20 topology and approves reboot/recovery; automation may then perform cross-structure reconciliation.
required_inputs: Disposition of Manufacturer/chassis/status/serial/asset/security fields versus Type 20 scope
Expected Type 20 record count, effective ranges, device handles, row position, interleave position and depth
Authoritative Type 17 device-handle inventory and Type 19 enclosing array ranges
Rules for non-interleaved sentinel values and legacy-versus-extended address representation
Any retained companion-structure matrices and protected data policy

Require reboot approval and stop on wrong target or recovery failure
No automatic retry or guessed topology

Collect full Type 20, referenced Type 17/19 and approved companion structures

Approve Type 17/19/20 memory-device topology and reboot/recovery
Review topology or persistence deviations and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 20` targets the declared structure, but `grep -A1` drops every named mapping field and cannot validate Type 17/19 relationships or copied chassis fields; transport and reboot coverage are also deficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After owner mapping, securely collect complete Type 20 plus referenced Type 17/19 and approved companion structures before/after reboot, then perform normalized topology reconciliation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All Type 20 ranges, device/interleave fields, mixed companion fields, reboot persistence, source script and 5/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For every Type 20 entry, resolve its Type 17 memory device, effective address interval and enclosing Type 19 array range, then validate row/interleave position/depth as a coherent group against the owner topology across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the cross-structure relationships that give individual Type 20 fields meaning and refuses destructive/log-filtered shortcuts.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Plausible Type 20 values can still be invalid if the handle is orphaned, the device range falls outside Type 19, or interleave members disagree; a heading snippet detects none of these.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Interleave and partition semantics vary by platform and sentinel encoding. They cannot be inferred reliably from memory size or address adjacency alone.

project_override_considerations: Allowed sparse ranges, non-interleaved markers or topology changes must be tied to exact recipe/BIOS identity; removal of copied companion fields needs explicit source governance.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and owner field-to-structure disposition
Approved Type 17/19/20 topology and any companion matrices
Complete pre/post raw records for Type 20 and referenced Type 17/19 handles
Per-device effective interval, enclosing range, row/interleave-group and persistence reconciliation
Preserved logs, reboot timeline, no-clear/no-write/no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Type 20 item/command concern memory-device mapped addresses, while the Procedure also demands Manufacturer, Chassis Type/Status, Version, Serial, Asset Tag and Security fields from other SMBIOS structures. Their intended ownership is not defined.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review and conflict tracking are complete. Execution waits for field mapping, memory topology and reboot approval, but the review sequence can continue.

review_improvement: Preserves all named fields and adds the Type 20-to-Type 17/19 handle, range and interleave invariants required for actual device-map correctness.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Type 20 row is not independently trustworthy: its Memory Device Handle must resolve to the intended Type 17 device, and its effective interval must sit within the corresponding Type 19 array mapping. Interleave position and depth are group properties, so accepting each record separately can miss duplicate positions or incomplete groups. These relationships require complete topology evidence; the copied chassis fields remain a separate owner decision.
